svg.text: SI CONSOLE
04 CASE DRAWINGS
REV R3 | DATE 2026-11-23
DRAFT REFERENCE, NOT FOR SUBMISSION
Laser-cut acrylic panels, front/top/exploded views. Dimensions in mm.
CASE: CLEAR 3 mm LASER-CUT ACRYLIC, FINGER JOINTS, OUTER 360 W x 240 D x 140 H mm ASSUMED, FRONT/BACK 360 x 134
Scale: drawings below are not to scale. Dimensions in mm are the authority. Kerf 0.2 mm ASSUMED. Test joints on scrap first.
FRONT 360 x 134
Holes, centres from top-left of panel:
LEDs 5.2 mm: X 70,100,130,160 Y 22 ASSUMED
GREEN 30.2 mm: X 70 Y 75. RED 30.2 mm: X 150 Y 75
KILL 22.3 mm: X 235 Y 75. PTT 12.2 mm: X 295 Y 75
TOGGLE 12.2 mm: X 330 Y 75 ASSUMED
Grille: 20 holes 3 mm, 40x40, X300 Y100 ASSUMED
Finger teeth 15 mm wide, 3 mm deep, all edges
BACK 360 x 134
Cable cutouts, rear wall:
micro HDMI main plus mini, one shared slot 29x5 mm, X 61 to 90, Z centred 14
Two separate 15 mm slots would overlap, ports are 13 mm apart at centres.
USB-C power in 10x5 mm ASSUMED, X 46 to 56, Z centred 14. R3 fix: R2 put the
cutouts at Y 20 from the top, Z about 112 to 117, wrong for a bottom-mounted Pi.
Vent slots: 6 slots 4x20 mm, low, X 40-200 Y 100. Pi USB / ETH access: do not cut large window
Finger teeth 15 mm wide, all edges
TOP 360 x 240
Mini screen bezel cutout:
Cutout 122 x 90.5 mm ASSUMED, X 119 Y 75
Screen module 121 x 89.48 mm VERIFIED size
Screw holes 3.2 mm ASSUMED, corners offset 5 mm
Vent slots near rear: 6 slots 4x20 mm ASSUMED
Finger teeth 15 mm wide, all edges
BOTTOM 360 x 240
No holes except:
4x Pi standoff holes M2.5, see Pi outline
4x rubber feet holes 5 mm ASSUMED
Vent slots: none on bottom. Dust and spills.
Finger teeth 15 mm wide, all edges
LEFT SIDE 234 x 134 ASSUMED
Panel size ASSUMED: 240 minus 2x3 mm joints
Vent slots: 6 slots 4x20 mm, high, exhaust
Finger teeth 15 mm wide, all edges
No cable holes on left side
RIGHT SIDE 234 x 134 ASSUMED
Panel size ASSUMED: 240 minus 2x3 mm joints
Vent slots: 6 slots 4x20 mm, high, exhaust
Cable gland hole 12 mm ASSUMED, optional
Finger teeth 15 mm wide, all edges
FRONT VIEW, TOP VIEW, EXPLODED ASSEMBLY
FRONT VIEW 360 x 134
G
R
K
P
L
G green, R red, K kill, P PTT, L LANG. LEDs top row.
TOP VIEW 360 x 240, NOT TO SCALE
MINI SCREEN
Screen at front-left of top panel ASSUMED.
EXPLODED, TOP TO BOTTOM
TOP + MINI SCREEN
FRONT / BACK / SIDES
PI 5 + COOLER
PERFBOARD + ULN2003
USB SOUNDBAR
BOTTOM
Inside: Pi rear left, perfboard centre, soundbar front right, 20 mm gap Pi to soundbar, 50 mm clear behind buttons, 75 mm behind kill.
Cardboard mockup first. Paper template at 100 percent scale on real panels. Drill / cut test hole in scrap first.
Hole clearance: buttons 30.2 mm for 30 mm, kill 22.3 mm for 22 mm, PTT/toggle 12.2 mm for 12 mm, LEDs 5.2 mm for 5 mm.
Snap-in buttons need 1-5 mm panel. 3 mm acrylic satisfies this. VERIFIED from previous blueprint.
Optional variant: plywood front panel, 3 mm, same laser, same holes. Hides electronics. Decide in CAD phase.
Sheets: 6 total, Fovorica 4-pack plus Langaelex 2-pack, 12x16 inch cast acrylic, 52.98 CAD LIKELY. See BOM.csv.
MSI MP165 E6 356.5 x 210.35 mm, 0.78 kg VERIFIED, sits behind case. Case 360 mm wide is only 3.5 mm wider than monitor.
Option B case, black nylon factory print: about 125 to 145 CAD all in at JLCPCB, ASSUMED, not a real quote. Arrives by Dec 1 only via JLCPCB, no slack. Same panel sizes if printed flat.
Nylon finger joints differ from laser cut. Confirm wall thickness and minimum feature size with the print service before using this drawing.

Option B mini screen: no 5.5 inch Waveshare DSI exists. Real DSI option is the 5 inch DSI LCD, 121 x 76 mm, cutout about 122 x 77 mm ASSUMED. Ribbon cable, not HDMI. Do not cut the top panel for DSI yet.
ASSUMPTIONS
* Case outer size 360 x 240 x 140 mm ASSUMED proposal from W3, not a CAD result. Confirm before cutting.
* Front panel hole centres ASSUMED. Measure real buttons with calipers and test in cardboard first.

* R2 fix: front/back 360 x 134 mm, side 234 x 134 mm, outer height 140 mm with top/bottom 3 mm each. Front/back height is 140 minus 2x3 mm. Side depth is 240 minus 2x3 mm. Check in CAD before cutting.
* Mini screen cutout 122 x 90.5 mm ASSUMED, 0.5-1.0 mm clearance over 121 x 89.48 mm module.
* Vent slot count, size and position ASSUMED. Speaker grille size and position ASSUMED.
* Kerf 0.2 mm ASSUMED. Finger tooth width 15 mm ASSUMED. Screw hole 3.2 mm ASSUMED.
* Top view and exploded view are not to scale. Dimensions in text are the authority.
* Top view mini screen rect is 122 x 90.5 mm in R2, was 122 x 70 mm in R1.
* R2 check: front view hole positions match the text list. Panel origin is x20 in this drawing.
* G cx90 is X70, R cx170 is X150, K cx255 is X235, P cx315 is X295, L cx350 is X330.
* LEDs cx90,120,150,180 are X70,100,130,160. Toggle centre X330, edge at 336.1 mm, inside the 360 mm panel.
* Front view circles are symbolic, not to scale.
